audit.scope: Targeted basket-spread reduction audit; not an exhaustive review of every catalogue item.
audit.reference_caveat: Research sources are retailer product listings and independent comparison services; ordinary non-promotion status not independently verified.
audit.instructions: Use actual complete-pack quantities and each product price_min/price_max; do not silently substitute SKU or treat comparison prices as guaranteed branch checkout prices.

retailer_offers_status: Full catalogue coverage audit (15 October 2026). Where retailer offers exist they are named-product online listing observations, with source URLs and correct pack sizes. A missing retailer means NO quoted price, NOT zero price. Do not extrapolate one supermarket's price to another.

retailer_audit.scope: All catalogue products reviewed for retailer-offer coverage. Published listing quotations added when usable. Many items remain unquoted because comparable live retailer listings were not established. Existing historical offers retained.
retailer_audit.limitation: PriceCheck comparisons are indicative, and some offers may represent promos, variable weights or matching alternative product forms. Branch checkout prices unverified.
retailer_audit.correction_note: Removed frozen drumstick offer under generic fresh/unspecified drumsticks, and salted-water tuna under brine because those are not guaranteed equivalent. Additional named quotes for beans, tomatoes and green beans added. 15 Oct: Removed all 1kg and variable-weight price-per-kg mince offers from 500g product identities. Comparisons are strictly 500g packaged offers.
retailer_audit.oil_research: Added avocado and flaxseed, 250/500/750/1000/2000ml oil offers, direct Woolworths product-page prices and independently attributed retailer quotes, plus approximate 25g fresh herb units
retailer_audit.precision_note: Spices in 39g, 40g, 41g, 42g and 60g alternative bottles are recorded with ACTUAL pack size; they must not be displayed as the price of a 100g pack. Mince remains strictly 500g.
